bagPolicy.summary: Small clutches, wristlets or fanny packs up to 6 × 9 inches, or clear plastic bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches, are permitted. All bags are searched; oversized bags and backpacks are prohibited.
allowed: Clutch, wristlet or fanny pack up to 6 × 9 inches
Clear plastic bag up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking is included with the ticket; Premier, Ultra Premier and Star parking are paid upgrades. Lots open at noon on show days according to the current venue guide.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Taxis and rideshare vehicles follow staff directions to enter through Gate C; pickup is also at Gate C.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: The venue sells food and drinks and is cashless; a cash-to-card exchange is offered near the main gates. Guests may bring food in one clear one-gallon resealable bag and an empty plastic bottle or up to one gallon of factory-sealed plain water in plastic.
allowed: Food in a clear one-gallon bag
Up to one gallon of sealed plain water in plastic
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue publishes a separate accessibility guide for arrival, parking and services; contact staff for needs at the show.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is prohibited; after leaving, a new ticket would be required to return.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The venue uses mobile entry: download the ticket to a phone in the Live Nation app. The box office opens two hours before doors on show days.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates usually open 90 minutes before showtime, but event-specific times can differ. Entry involves metal detectors, possible pat-downs and bag checks; use the event page for the actual gate time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
